about: S1 郊野 (the countryside): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; brief gen/life/brief_section.md; cast gen/life/cast/S1.md; readings 名画记 1-6, 21, 余辉 2015 看点一 and 2021, 《東京夢華錄》 卷三, 卷六, 卷七). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then. Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips. Plot-line steps told here: horse.1, horse.2 (the bolting horse), charcoal.1 (the charcoal donkeys), qingming.1 (the party home from the graves). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 驚馬闖市
scenes.reading: 余辉 2015 看点一 (疯狂的惊马): a white 官马 of the party coming home from the Qingming outing bolts (its front half lost to damage), grooms run after it, people panic, an old man hurries the child playing by the road home, another with a staff dodges aside, the diners in the stall look up. 余辉 2021: the horse is about to charge into the market ('那可是要出人命的'); the old man calls his little grandson indoors. The map: the man leans on the bar of a tall post by the vegetable field, arm out to the child; three grooms run west after the horse. Chosen: 余辉's reading (the horse is the returning party's, the child his grandson); 名画记 has no note on the horse. Its pin 5 (一片青铜海) is the vegetable field beside him: the second again set.

scenes.title: 騎驢客商
scenes.reading: 名画记 4 (骑驴客商): a party coming out of the city along the wall, rich men or merchants by their dress; the front one turns back to talk to the one behind, concerned; the old servant at the head turns his ear to listen; luggage on their shoulders, a long road ahead. 余辉 2014 迎寒策蹇 (riding donkeys bundled against the cold). 余辉 2021: the painter sets weary travellers beside the merry nobles coming home from the outing, and common people greet each other warmly when they meet. 余辉 2015/2021: a donkey ahead of the bolting horse takes fright. The map: two hooded riders going east, a man with a staff and a bundle walking between them, a stout open-mouthed man leading the second donkey, a man with a stick and a bag standing at the west end facing them. Chosen: 名画记 4's merchants leaving town; the leader is its old servant and the standing man a passer-by greeting them (our proposals); the startled donkey is theirs (our reading of 余辉).

scenes.title: 上墳回城
scenes.reading: 名画记 6 (杨柳杂花装簇轿顶): the party is coming back to town from sweeping the graves at Qingming; a servant clears the way, the lady's sedan is decked with willow and flowers, the master rides at the rear, and they go fast. 東京夢華錄 卷七 清明節: new graves are swept on this day and the city goes out to the country for three days; people picnic under the trees and come home with 門外土 (棗錮, 炊餅, 黃胖 clay dolls, toy knives); the sedans are decked with willow and flowers. 余辉 2021: an official rides, his lady sits in the flowered sedan, and someone carries two pheasants they shot, though hunting was banned from the second to the ninth month; 余辉 2015: the white horse that bolts is theirs. The map: two bearers, porters with a pole load and a pair of boxes, a walker, a porter with a staff, one rider. The lady is not painted (the box is closed): nobody speaks for her. Which load holds 余辉's pheasants is ours (the map reads a basket and a long bundle).

scenes.title: 趕驢送炭
scenes.reading: 名画记 1 (赶驴入城): two drovers drive several donkeys loaded with charcoal toward the small bridge, the front one driving them on toward it, leading us into the scroll; 名画记 21: the charcoal the donkey train brings into town feeds the riverside taverns' stoves, which have several fire-mouths. The map: five donkeys in a file, the front driver leaning back to the lead donkey with a hand on its load and a switch in the other, a faint second driver at the rear with a stick over the last donkey; two donkeys hang their heads. As painted (the lead's call) the train walks east toward the bridge, against the title's 入城: the lines say they drive to the bridge and the charcoal is for the town's taverns, not which way the road runs. 東京夢華錄 卷三 般載雜賣: pack panniers of leather or bamboo slung on both sides. 孔宪易's reading of the charcoal as an autumn sign is not voiced.

scenes.title: 寂靜的穀場
scenes.reading: 名画记 2 (寂静的谷场): past the little bridge, a roadside rest stop with an awning and chairs; it is early, no guests have come, and the owner is busy on the threshing floor behind the house. 余辉 2014 晒场农舍. 名画记 1: early spring, a little chill in the air. 名画记 3: the willows are pollarded and their cut branches bundled for the dykes. 余辉 2021: the palace exams fall a fortnight after Qingming. The map: a farmer behind the hedge with his hands in his sleeves, a figure crouching under the threshing-floor shed (low confidence), a bending figure at the yard's fence, a pollarded willow by the floor. That the crouching one is 名画记's owner is our proposal. No line names the hour (the world's hour is the viewer's clock).

beats.src: 余辉 2015 (the bolting white 官马 is the party's)

say_en: Send the grooms after it!
Don't panic, the grooms are after it.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (grooms chasing), 2021 (the party panics)

think_en: We'll be late getting home now.
beats.src: our proposal

say_en: Fresh earth on the ancestors' graves.
The willow by the grave has grown again.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷七 (拜掃); our proposal

say_en: All year we look forward to these days out.
The flowers out here are at their best.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷七 (四野如市…名花異果); our proposal

chatter.title: 騎驢客商
chatter.reading: 名画记 4 (merchants leaving town, the front one turning back to talk with concern, the old servant listening, luggage on their shoulders, a long road); 余辉 2014 迎寒策蹇 (hooded against the cold); 余辉 2015/2021 (a donkey takes fright at the bolting horse: ours, that it is theirs); 余辉 2021 (common people greet each other; weary travellers beside the merry party coming home).

porter.name: 腳夫
porter.src: 名画记 4 (肩挑着行旅); map

servant.name: 老僕
servant.src: 名画记 4 (老仆人; the identification is ours); map

say_en: Have you seen to everything at home?
Is everything settled at the farm?
beats.src: 名画记 4 (前面的人正回头与后面的人交谈，神态关切)

say_en: I have, but I still worry.
It's settled. Don't worry.
beats.src: 名画记 4 (神态关切); our proposal

think_en: The master's on about home again.
beats.src: 名画记 4 (走在队伍前方的老仆人，正回头侧耳倾听着谈话)

say_en: This wind is cold.
Wrap your hood tighter.
beats.src: 余辉 2014 迎寒策蹇; the map (hooded)

say_en: Out of town the wind's worse.
There's an inn ahead to rest at.
beats.src: our proposal (名画记 2's roadside rest stop lies east, ahead of them)

say_en: Whoa — easy, easy.
Steady, slow down.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (a startled donkey ahead of the white horse), 2021 (有只驴子也受了惊吓); that it is this donkey is our proposal

say_en: What's that racket behind us?
Why's the donkey spooked?
beats.src: our proposal (on 余辉 2015)

say_en: Sounds like a horse has bolted.
Don't look back. Keep going.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (the bolting horse behind them)

say_en: This luggage gets heavier every step.
Still a long way to go.
beats.src: 名画记 4 (他们肩挑着行旅，似乎路途不近)

say_en: Take care on the road!
Come back soon!
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (百姓相遇，招呼频频)

think: 人家都回城，他們倒出城。
think_en: Everyone's heading home, and they're heading out.
A long journey, in weather like this.
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (困顿的出行者与欢快的踏青返城的贵族对比); our proposal

chatter.title: 趕驢送炭
chatter.reading: 名画记 1 (two drovers drive charcoal donkeys toward the small bridge), 名画记 21 (the charcoal is for the town's tavern stoves); 東京夢華錄 卷三 (pack panniers of leather or bamboo); the map (two donkeys hang their heads; the front driver's hand on the lead donkey's load). The train walks east as painted; the lines name the bridge and the town's taverns, not the road's direction.

say_en: Gee up! On to the bridge.
Bridge ahead. Steady now.
beats.src: 名画记 1 (驮着木炭向小桥走来)

say_en: The back's keeping up!
Come on, no dawdling.
beats.src: the map (the rear driver, a stick over the last donkey); our proposal

say: 這幾馱炭，送進城裏酒店。
城裏酒店，等著這炭燒灶。
say_en: This charcoal goes to the taverns in town.
The town's taverns are waiting on it for their stoves.
beats.src: 名画记 1 (两个脚夫赶着几匹毛驴，驮着木炭), 21 (驴队往城里运送的木炭，正是满足这些酒店所需)

say_en: Sell early, home early.
Sell the charcoal, buy a bowl of wine.
beats.src: our proposal

say_en: This donkey's hanging its head again.
These two donkeys are worn out.
beats.src: the map (D2 and D3 hang their heads low)

say_en: Rest a bit, then go on.
Don't hurry them. Slowly does it.
beats.src: our proposal

say_en: Don't let the bamboo panniers slip.
Are the baskets balanced?
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷三 般載雜賣 (駝騾驢馱子，或皮或竹為之…兩搭背上)

say_en: Balanced.
I've got a hand on it.
beats.src: the map (his hand on the lead donkey's load)

chatter.title: 村店歇腳
chatter.reading: 余辉 2015 (the diners in the shop look up at the bolting horse's noise), 2021 (the tea drinkers look out; at the scroll's start the man eating in the little shop is a farmer come to town for day work, in the lean months between harvests). The map: a customer seated at the small table, a man with a bundle on his back standing under the west eave, a water buffalo lying and an ox standing in front. Who keeps the stall is not settled: neither speaks as the keeper.

diner.name: 食客
diner.src: 余辉 2015 (坐在店铺里的食客); map (seated at the small table, low confidence)

guest.name: 行客
guest.src: map (standing under the west eave, a bundle on his back)

say_en: What's that noise outside?
Hey, who's shouting?
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (食客闻声而望), 2021 (他们纷纷寻声外望)

say_en: Sounds like a horse has bolted.
They're shouting to stop a horse.
beats.src: 余辉 2015 (疯狂的惊马)

say_en: Off to town to find some day work.
They say there's work to be had in town.
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (饥民们进城寻找打短工的机会; 卷首 the man eating in the little shop)

say_en: Between harvests, it's hard on everyone.
Lots of people in town. There's always work.
beats.src: 余辉 2021 (在这青黄不接的日子里)

think: 這碗熱湯下肚，暖和多了。
think_en: That hot bowl warms you right up.
Eat your fill, then take the road.
beats.src: the map (at the tea and food stall); our proposal

say_en: That buffalo's sleeping soundly.
The beasts are resting, so can we.
beats.src: the map (a water buffalo lying and an ox standing before the stall)

say_en: Who on the road isn't tired?
beats.src: our proposal

chatter.title: 坡上鋤菜
chatter.reading: The map: two tiny far figures crouching together on the terraced fields at the top (low confidence: farmers at work). 名画记 5 (the outskirts are vegetable gardens, worth ten times grain); 東京夢華錄 卷六 (no idle land within a hundred li). A quiet pair: long gaps.

a.name: 農夫
a.src: map (crouching on the terrace, low confidence)

say_en: This row needs weeding.
The weeds are back.
beats.src: 名画记 5 (城郊皆是菜园); the map (crouching at work); our proposal

say_en: Let's pull them now.
Squat down and pull them slowly.
beats.src: our proposal

say_en: Not an inch of land out here lies idle.
For a hundred li round the city, it's all gardens.
beats.src: 東京夢華錄 卷六 (大抵都城左近，皆是園圃，百里之內，並無閑地); 名画记 5 (城郊百里之内，皆是菜园)

say_en: Vegetables pay better than grain.
These vegetables sell well in town.
beats.src: 名画记 5 (种菜的收益要十倍于种田)

chatter.title: 田頭歇牛
chatter.reading: The map: two tiny far figures, one in a hat, standing beside a long low animal (an ox?) on the terraced fields at the top (low confidence: perhaps a ploughman behind his ox). Lines: our proposal. A quiet pair: long gaps.

a.name: 農夫
a.src: map (by the far ox, low confidence)

hat.name: 農夫
hat.src: map (in a hat, by the far ox, low confidence)

say_en: Has the ox rested enough?
Hitch the plough, another stretch.
beats.src: the map (an ox, or a plough behind an ox: low confidence); our proposal

say_en: A little longer.
No hurry. The ox is tired too.
beats.src: our proposal

think: 今春的雨水，不知夠不夠。
think_en: Will there be rain enough this spring?
beats.src: our proposal (early spring, 名画记 1)

who.name: 農夫
who.src: the map (a hooked stick, a hoe?, on his shoulder; leaning west, arm out, calling or pointing)

say_en: Hey — a horse has bolted back there!
You up ahead, look out for the horse!
Hoe on my shoulder, off to the field.
barks.src: the map (calling west; its other reading: a warning of the runaway horse, 惊马闯市); 余辉 2015 (the people round about panic)

who.name: 店主
who.src: 名画记 2 (主人在屋后的谷场忙碌着); the map (crouching under the shed, low confidence)

think: 客人還沒來，先把活幹了。
think_en: This long plank still needs mending.
No guests yet. Get the work done first.
barks.src: 名画记 2 (还没有客人到来，主人在屋后的谷场忙碌着); the map (behind the long low plank)

who.name: 農夫
who.src: the map (bending at the yard's fence among low objects)

say_en: Oof — this basket's heavy.
Into the shed with it.
barks.src: the map (bending over low objects: baskets or a trough); 名画记 2 (the farm busy, no guests yet); our proposal
